description: Convert an amount from one currency to another. Returns {amount, currency} rounded to the target's minor units. Upstream rounds rates per direction; for low-value sources, flip via `get_rates` for more precision. Pass `provider` to use one institution's published rate, e.g. UST for a U.S. Treasury reporting rate.

amount.description: Amount in the source currency. Normalize localized input first: '100,50' -> 100.5; German '1.000,50' -> 1000.5; English '1,000.50' -> 1000.5.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD for a past rate; omit for latest.

from.description: Source currency or asset code, e.g. USD, XAU or BTC.

provider.description: Provider key, e.g. ECB for European Central Bank or UST for U.S. Treasury reporting rates. Serves that institution's published rates instead of the blend; a date inside a weekly, monthly or quarterly provider's period returns the rate in force. Keys at https://frankfurter.dev/providers/.

name: convert
title: Convert currency
